subject: Re: Status: lt-en repro green, production-size comparison running
body:
Team,

Adoption decision, settled a few days early:

1. ADOPT for optimizer hyperparameters (learning rate, warmup, decay) on the seq2seq stack. Csilla's token-budget accounting shows the learned arm reaching baseline BLEU with 28% less total compute once you charge the baseline for its search runs. That number goes to the portfolio review.
2. HOLD on learning regularization hyperparameters - the early-training spikes Kaia chased are mostly gone with the larger tuning-loss batch, but 1 in 5 seeds still restarts, and I will not put that into other teams' pipelines yet. Revisit as a Q3 item with the corpus regeneration work Bruno scheduled.
3. Rosa's container becomes the supported entry point; the raw pip route gets a deprecation note in the internal README.

Good, quantified work - this is the kind of decision memo I like writing.

Dmitri
